WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Commissioners are charged with the preservation of the health, welfare, and safety of Treutlen County and its citizens; and,

WHEREAS, at times certain conditions occur which create immediate fire hazards which could be devastating to Treutlen County and its citizens, resulting in the need for the declaration of an Emergency Burn Ban;

NOW THEREFORE, it is resolved and ordained that the following is adopted as an Ordinance of Treutlen County, Georgia.

1.

Upon the publication of a resolution declaring an Emergency Burn Ban by the Chairman of the Board of Commissioners, any and all outdoor open burning of any woods, lands, marshes, refuse/trash, or other combustible materials, is absolutely prohibited in the unincorporated portions of Treutlen County, Georgia. Publication shall be deemed effective by the Emergency Burn Ban being placed upon the Treutlen County Official Website. Once in place, an Emergency Burm Ban shall be deemed in effect until its official revocation or the expiration of sixty (60) days from its passage.

2.

The penalty for violating this Ordinance shall be a fine of up to $1,000.00, up to 30 days in the county jail, and restitution of the costs of firefighting and damages caused. This Ordinance shall be enforced in accordance with the State law.

3.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances that conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed. The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this ordinance are severable. Should any section, paragraph, sentence, clause, or phrase of this ordinance be rendered invalid by a court of law, the remaining sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, or phrases shall not be affected, but shall continue in effect until amended or repealed by action of the governing authority of Treutlen County, Georgia.

- 4. This ordinance shall go into effect immediately upon its adoption.

Adopted this 29*“day of April, 2026.
